ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1S5.1-TD1 Tick TailTrace is a bounded diagnostic build based directly on S5.1 Hybrid Tail Rescue for RimWorld 1.5. S5.1 gameplay behavior is unchanged. TD1 keeps only the existing DoSingleTick timing bracket during normal play. After warmup, the first live DoSingleTick at or above 32ms triggers temporary broad category probes for TickList, Pawn and pawn subsystems, JobGiver, Map/MapComponent, World/WorldComponent, GameComponent, Storyteller, Quest, WorldPawns and PathFinder. Only later ticks at or above 32ms are retained. The temporary probes automatically unpatch after 12 slow ticks or 1200 observed capture ticks. Category timings are inclusive and intended to identify the next subsystem for focused optimization, not for clean performance benchmarking.
